_doc: Fault injection for the hospital demo (scenario 3), OFF by default. In the live data on 2026-11-14 several plant-based cooking bases with complete allergen evidence (no milk, gluten-free) arrive on Monday, so the time pressure of the scenario does not occur by itself. When this fixture is switched on (UI checkbox or AGENT_SIMULATE=hospital_delay), the availability responses are changed AFTER they are received: the products below arrive delay_days later. The UI banner and the audit trail say SIMULATED and list the products; the SHA-256 in the audit is still the hash of the real, unchanged response. The list is every product in categories 10401/10402/10406 whose milk-protein + gluten verdict was pass on 2026-11-14 (catalog.allergen_verdict).
label: SIMULATED: one-day delay for plant-based cooking bases with complete allergen evidence
